query: Which policy covers damage to my home caused by fire?
justification: Cosine similarity is appropriate because embedding vectors are compared by direction in vector space, and this metric captures semantic overlap without being dominated by vector magnitude.

ranked_chunks.text: Property insurance protects homes and buildings against fire and storm damage.
Motor insurance protects vehicles against accidents and theft.
Health insurance covers medical expenses for treatment and hospitalization.
Claims are settled after the insurer approves evidence and completes assessment.
Travel insurance covers emergency trips and overseas medical support.
